title: DNR Book Launch
content:
Founded in 2021, DNR began as a private chat server where artists gathered to discuss memetics and emergent political trends. Today, the blog has published work by nearly 400 contributors from around the world. This is our fourth anthology volume.

You can buy the book online now.

Shipping is available for the US only. International orders can be placed via major retailer sites: Barnes & Nobles, Amazon, Blackwell’s, others.
